entries.name: PLINK
entries.definition: A free, open-source command-line toolset for analysing genotype data, mainly in genome-wide association studies and population genetics.

entries.name: Plumbing drawing
entries.definition: Preparing or reading technical drawings that show the layout of pipes and fixtures in a building.

entries.name: Plumbing plans examination
entries.definition: Reviewing plumbing plans to check that they comply with the plumbing code, typically before a building permit is issued.

entries.name: Point-to-Point Tunneling Protocol
entries.definition: A network protocol, described in RFC 2637, that carries PPP traffic through a tunnel to build virtual private networks.

entries.name: Police accountability
entries.definition: The laws, oversight bodies and practices, such as civilian review and use-of-force reporting, that hold police answerable for their conduct.

entries.name: Police baton
entries.definition: A short club or telescoping rod carried by police and security officers for defensive control.

entries.name: Policy analysis
entries.definition: Evaluating public policies and their alternatives, costs and likely effects so as to advise the people who decide.

entries.name: Policy research and analysis
entries.definition: Researching public problems and the options for dealing with them, and presenting the evidence to people who make policy.

entries.name: Poll Everywhere
entries.definition: An online audience-response service where a presenter asks questions and participants answer from their phones or browsers, with results shown live.

entries.name: Polycom
entries.definition: Video and audio conferencing equipment and software from Polycom, a company that later became part of Poly.

entries.name: Positive airway pressure
entries.definition: Treating breathing problems such as sleep apnea by delivering pressurised air through a mask to keep the airway open, as CPAP and BiPAP machines do.

entries.name: POSIX
entries.definition: A family of IEEE standards that define a common interface for Unix-like operating systems, covering the shell, utilities and programming interfaces.

entries.name: Post Office Protocol
entries.definition: An internet email protocol that lets a mail program download messages from a mail server; its current version is POP3.

entries.name: PostCSS
entries.definition: A JavaScript tool that transforms CSS through plugins, for example to add vendor prefixes or allow newer syntax.

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.definition: An open-source relational database system queried with SQL.

entries.name: Postman
entries.definition: A desktop and cloud application for building, testing and documenting APIs by sending requests and inspecting the responses.

entries.name: Postorder traversal
entries.definition: Visiting every node of a tree by processing a node's children before the node itself.

entries.name: PouchDB
entries.definition: An open-source JavaScript database that runs in the browser or Node.js and can synchronise with CouchDB.

entries.name: Power Automate
entries.definition: Microsoft's cloud service for building automated workflows between apps and services, first released as Microsoft Flow.

entries.name: Power flow study
entries.definition: Calculating the voltages and the real and reactive power flowing through an electrical power system under given load conditions.

entries.name: Power tool operation
entries.definition: Using powered hand and bench tools, such as drills, saws and sanders, to cut, shape or join materials.

entries.name: Powered industrial truck operation
entries.definition: Driving forklifts and other powered industrial trucks to move and stack loads; in the United States OSHA requires employers to train and evaluate operators.

entries.name: PowerSchool
entries.definition: A cloud-based student information system for schools and districts, used for attendance, grades, scheduling and communication with families.

entries.name: Pre-sales engineering
entries.definition: Supporting the sales process by learning a customer's needs, demonstrating the product and designing a technical solution before the sale.

entries.name: Predictive analytics software
entries.definition: Software that applies statistical and machine-learning models to existing data to forecast future outcomes.

entries.name: Predictive modelling
entries.definition: Building statistical or machine-learning models that use known data to predict future or unknown outcomes.

entries.name: Presentation design
entries.definition: Designing slides and other visual presentation materials so that ideas are clear and engaging.

entries.name: Presentation software
entries.definition: Software for building and showing slide-based presentations, such as PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides.

entries.name: PrestoDB
entries.definition: The open-source distributed SQL query engine first developed at Facebook, now hosted by the Linux Foundation as Presto.

entries.name: Preventive dental care
entries.definition: Helping patients avoid tooth and gum disease through examinations, cleanings, fluoride, sealants and oral-hygiene teaching.

entries.name: Prezi
entries.definition: A cloud-based presentation tool that lays content out on a large zoomable canvas instead of separate slides.

entries.name: Price negotiation
entries.definition: Negotiating the price of goods or services with customers or suppliers.

entries.name: Price-to-book ratio
entries.definition: A valuation ratio that divides a company's share price by its book value per share, which is its assets minus its liabilities divided by its shares.

entries.name: PrimeRx
entries.definition: Pharmacy management software used to handle prescriptions, billing and inventory in a pharmacy.

entries.name: PRINCE2
entries.definition: A process-based method for managing projects in defined stages, first developed for the UK government.

entries.name: Principles for Responsible Banking
entries.definition: A voluntary framework launched in 2019 by the UN Environment Programme Finance Initiative for banks to align their strategy and business with the UN Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement.

entries.name: Print design
entries.definition: Designing layouts and artwork for printed materials such as brochures, posters and packaging.

entries.name: Printed circuit board design
entries.definition: Laying out the components and copper connections of a printed circuit board from an electronic schematic.

entries.name: Prisoners' rights
entries.definition: The legal rights of people held in prisons and jails, such as protection from cruel treatment and access to the courts.

entries.name: Privacy impact assessment
entries.definition: A structured process for finding and reducing the privacy risks of a project, system or policy that handles personal information.
